research_question: Does the complete regime-adaptive planner improve the joint wiping outcome relative to the same force-conditioned checkpoint with fixed objective and fixed compute under isolated environment shifts?
factor_isolation: All blocks share target-independent scenario seed, residual seed, tool, disturbance, path length, plant mass, damping ratio, and restitution. Each non-reference block changes only the fields named by its factor level.
common_random_numbers: Within each seed-block-target pair, M1 and M4 share the per-control-step planner random stream.

frozen_method_selection.selection_basis: The prespecified development rule first compared force-limit violations, task successes and tracking passes, then mean target-normalised RMSE and mean relative error. All three modes tied on the first three outcomes; force_only had the lowest mean NRMSE and MRE.

primary_outcome: joint task completion, tracking MRE <= 15%, tracking NRMSE <= 20%, and zero native samples above 15 N
analysis: paired seed-block-target differences with block- and seed-aware bootstrap intervals; factor panels reported separately; no claim of random-population generalisation
execution_rule: Run only after the method, BC coefficient, and risk-envelope mode are frozen from development evidence. Complete and report all 270 evaluations regardless of scientific outcome.
